title: Large-dimensional structured attack on the half-depth conjecture
objective: Find a counterexample or asymptotically tight non-rank-one family for H_ceil(n/2)(A)>=(mu/2)A^{-1}, using symmetry-reduced large-dimensional and multiscale families rather than repeating small random Gram searches.
acceptance_checks: Includes at least one family with three or more exchangeable groups and one multiscale spectral family.
Computes the full generalized minimum or a symmetry-proved reducing block, not only a kernel compression.
Any negative margin is reconstructed by exact rational or certified interval arithmetic before being called a counterexample.
Null search results are labelled E1 and include seeds and evaluation counts.
